svg.text: Projection lands the hit and sets a state. Absorption reads the state and finishes it.
docs/core_loop · proposal, nothing approved · design illustration, not in-game art
The hand leads. The tip follows
No hit. It is only the reach.
It hits what it crosses, once per
A stroke tires past it. Reverse to
A sharp reversal. 1.5 times at the tip, and
it sets the school's state. A snap forces
A brand marks a creature for the draw at twice the reach. What the draw
does then depends on the state your strand left on it.
It pulls the target to you. More blood comes back.
A faster, harder draw. Less blood comes back.
It deepens the slow and holds the target still.
It strips armour for as long as the draw holds.
A kill by draw spreads the Necrosis.
The draw arcs on to the next marked creature.
The draw reaches half as far again.
The target loses you, and you are Veiled.
